body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sony presented its 17-inch board pc ‘VGC-LM17L’ during KES 2007, it contains all the computing components such as CPU and mainboard on the backside of the screen. It has high performance speaker on both sides of the screen and it is designed as such that users can listen to music even if they turn off the monitor. Other features include a foldaway keyboard, touchpad, webcam and etc. It is expected to be available in Korea market in November, and suggested price is around 1,000,000(KRW).
